confidence_notes: City cost indexes provide recent meal, beer and cappuccino anchors, though mid-range meals and drinks have thinner data. comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Santa Marta's Colombian Caribbean-coast setting, local dining and beach tourism; accommodation reflects modest coastal guesthouses and hostels, generally below upscale Cartagena levels.
